newsitem.title: USA: FOCUS - U.S. firms await Burmese sanctions details.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS - U.S. firms await Burmese sanctions details.

text.p: U.S. companies initially expressed disappointment with tightened sanctions against the Burmese military regime, though they will have to wait until later this week to fully assess the impact on their major projects.

Secretary of State Madelaine Albright announced Tuesday that the administration had decided to strengthen existing sanctions because of a worsening human rights situation, imposing a ban on "new investment" by Americans.
